nom: NUDESTIX NUDESKIN 5% Citrus Fruit & Glycolic Glow Toner

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including some who normally avoid toners because they find them drying, report this one leaves their skin soft and hydrated rather than making dryness worse.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin report the acid is gentle enough for them once they ease in, with no irritation, but several others describe a slight sting or tingle at first and one reviewer who says she has never had sensitive skin before reports her cheeks became red and inflamed, with irritation later spreading to her nose and chin.
segments.oily: The reviewers who describe their skin as oily and acne-prone report it helped regulate oil production, reduced the look of their pores and improved their skin's texture.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, including some who also call it sensitive, report smoother, brighter, less congested skin with regular use.

concerns.aging: Reviewers using it for fine lines and texture report visible smoothing, including one who says a deep line between her eyebrows was noticeably less visible within two days of use.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers overwhelmingly report the toner does not dry out their skin the way other glycolic or exfoliating toners have, and several describe it as actively hydrating, though a couple say it merely stopped their existing dryness from getting worse rather than resolving it.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with no history of sensitive skin reports her cheeks became red and inflamed after her first two uses, with irritation spreading to her nose and chin, while other reviewers report no redness or stinging at all with regular use.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer cautions that using the toner too often, especially with sensitive skin, could be harsh on the skin barrier and recommends limiting frequency.
concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers, including some who are acne-prone or break out around their period, report fewer breakouts and clearer skin, with one saying it cleared her back acne; a handful of others, however, report a few new pimples or a temporary bout of underlying acne surfacing after they started using it.
concerns.oiliness: The reviewers who describe their skin as oily and acne-prone report the toner helped with oil production alongside reducing the look of their pores.

aspects.libelle: Pump dispenser is awkward, sprays or leaks
Light citrus scent that fades quickly
Good value, a little lasts a long time
Doubles as a body exfoliant for bumps and ingrown hairs

extraits.titre: Too harsh, not for every day
extraits.texte: I purchased this because I needed to replace my previous toner that was discontinued. I should have read the "how to use" section before purchasing because I didn't realize that this is only meant to be used 3 to 5 times per week. The first time I used it with my nighttime skincare routine, my cheeks were very red and inflamed the next morning. About a week later, I decided to try it again. In addition to red cheeks, the irritation had spread to my nose and chin as well. I have never had sensitive skin, so I'm surprised that this irritated my skin so much. I think maybe this product is just too harsh for me.

I have very dry skin so I don't normally use toners as I find them too drying for my skin; however this is the first toner I have used that I find didn't dry out my skin after using it. The citrus fruit smell is also very light and refreshing.I was using it every other day and the first few times it felt very refreshing and I got a very very subtle tingling from it (more refreshing than anything). However around the second week the tingling started growing stronger closer to a burning feeling (like when your skin is sensitive). My skin can sometimes be sensitive and I do know that it can also take time for your skin to get used to glycolic acid so I will keep using it for the meanwhile.

extraits.titre: Cleared my skin up in only a couple weeks
extraits.texte: I noticed a difference after the first use but now that I've been using it for around a month I've noticed a significant difference. I haven't changed anything else about my skincare routine but even when I would normally get acne around the time of my period I haven't gotten any breakouts. It's a bit difficult to apply if you put it on toilet paper or makeup pads then your skin but I just make sure my hands are clean and I apply it directly to my skin after I wash my face and then rub it in that way. I texted my mom right after I got it and asked her to buy this for my bday I absolutely love it. Especially after a night out I've found it prevents any pore clogging and new acne from forming. I use this on backne as well and it's cleared everything up so far.

I thought I was happy with my previous drugstore toner until I recieved this as a trial product. Immediately I noticed how gentle and moisturizing it felt on the skin while still removing impurities. It does not habe a stromg smell or burn my skin at all. I have this deep wrinkle in between my eyebrows that I have been contemplating botox for a while about and by day 2 of using this toner it is hardly visible. My skin feels better plumper and is glowing. My husband mentioned how much nicer my skin looked than his this morning and he has no idea I'm using a new product. I love it so much I will be buying more Nudestix products.

I have used this toner for a couple of weeks. It's easy to use and can feel the exfoliation. The mix of citrus fruits extracts and glycolic acid is somethingnew for my skin. I am generally oily and acne prone. The scent is not overpowering. It aids in reducing the look of my pores and my skin texture overall improves. It leaves you with a healthy glow. I will continue using this toner on a occasional basis as my acne prone skin is hormonal and changes throughout the month. This is a product that I will have on my skincare shelf.

I am an instant fan of the NUDESTIX 5% Citrus Fruit & Glycolic Glow Toner! I have sensitive skin so I am always careful about exfoliants. But this formula is gentle enough for me to use a few times a week. It leaves my skin hydrated bright and glowing. And it feels so soft the next day. I recommend this to anyone looking for an effective exfoliant that works well for sensitive skin.

extraits.titre: The toner the skin care industry was missing!
extraits.texte: I love that this is a clean skin care product that you can see an see the results almost immediately. This toner leaves your skin feeling soft clean and bright. I have dry sensative skin and this worked great for me and it has a light citrus smell. The packaging is awesome too! I would definitely recommend this product.
